description: Replacing the parent clauses \(\{p\}\) and \(\{\neg p,q\}\) by their resolvent \(\{q\}\) loses information: the valuation \(p=0,q=1\) satisfies the resolvent but not both parents.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.Resolution.replacing_parents_loses_information :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.ClauseSat (fun a => a == Lemmatheca.Entry.Resolution.q)
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.resolvent Lemmatheca.Entry.Resolution.p
        {Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.pos Lemmatheca.Entry.Resolution.p}
        {Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.neg Lemmatheca.Entry.Resolution.p,
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.pos Lemmatheca.Entry.Resolution.q}) ∧
    ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.Models (fun a => a == Lemmatheca.Entry.Resolution.q)
        {{Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.pos Lemmatheca.Entry.Resolution.p},
          {Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.neg Lemmatheca.Entry.Resolution.p,
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.pos Lemmatheca.Entry.Resolution.q}}
